finding.exception: System.InvalidOperationException: Local player not found in combat.
finding.root_cause: Replay removes NRun before graceful RunManager cleanup. CombatStateTracker then skips its one-frame defer because NRun.Instance is null. Creature detach/reset notifications synchronously look up a local player already removed while other creatures remain. TaskHelper logs/catches these exceptions, so target-state checks and completion still pass.
finding.proposed_fix_not_implemented: Skip only CombatStateTracker aggregate notification while Replay.OwnsCleanup tears down the discarded run; keep notifications active for the reconstructed combat.
finding.strict_verifier_change: Fuzz acceptance now fails on native [ERROR] System.* exceptions even when HARNESS_PASS was written.
